Yeah, me and my buddies had this issue that it was confusing where to look, and etc. Voting this up because I experienced this issue with a nice grouping of buddies. I had to point where the lens was. 

The camera also has a habit of locking up that you have to disable it and reactivate it again.
Does this still occur? If so, please let us know what world it occured in, and provide output logs if possible.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: This still occurs on the Live version, I have not tested it in the Beta as of yet.
It also occurs in every world with so far no exception, I reliably bump into it several times a day.
Will see if I can send in an outputlog that has the error occurring tomorrow, but it has been very reliable to reproduce and should be reproduceable by following the instructions in the main post.
Still invisible lenses at some streamers. So yes it's not fully solved. Some have visible, some have nothing visible. It looks random problem.
Hmm, this is broken again, I've seen all these problems happening over the past few weeks.

Can confirm that this is an issue again. Can usually be reproduced by opening the camera, then rejoining the instance. As soon as you load in *after* you opened the camera, other people wont see your camera.
@{58c6cbcffd04b1785f747b6c|full_name}: Unable to test directly at this time, but according to some friends who could, it still happens.

details:
Under certain circumstances, photo cameras (I imagine stream cameras aswell) will be invisible for other clients, which could be a bit worrying privacy-wise.
The camera still makes a sound when a picture is taken, but there is no lens or nametag visible for it. The quick menu does not reveal it either.

It seems to happen consistently when the camera was active before a world transition, might have something to do with the new initial client load.
title: Photo cameras are invisible for other players under certain circumstances
